svg.text: 2026-11-01 · one rock, one day, four pieces · 21 min 40 s · 31 cues
Each piece is 5 min 25 s, the whole day from 12 am to 11 pm. Read left to right. One mark is one pulse is one movement.
↑ / ↓ cue: rock more / less than forecast
│ a cue line: three soft chimes

g.text: grainline: the front of the rock,
the side that faced the window

svg.text: Seam allowance (hatched) is the checking hour: silence, change tools. Nothing is added to the rock.
